# 👋 Hi, I'm ningbojian

I mainly build AI agent tooling and automation utilities in Python and TypeScript, with some computer vision and desktop app work along the way. Representative projects include GitHub Trending Agent (a WeCom daily digest with natural-language search), ProfileReadmeAgent (a scheduled, incremental profile README template), and RoboArmDev-Showcase (OpenCV/HALCON image processing and a trajectory pipeline for a 6-DOF drawing arm), plus a LangGraph resource-guard middleware and an Electron todo board. I like turning ideas into complete, runnable workflows.
